body.statement: For a square invertible linear mixture of mutually independent nonconstant sources, of which at most one is Gaussian, the law of the mixture determines the mixing columns, and equivalently the projective rows of the inverse mixing matrix, up to permutation and nonzero coordinatewise scaling.

source.locator: Appendix B.1, Lemma 11, specialized to square invertible mixing matrices

upstream.citation: J. Eriksson and V. Koivunen. Identifiability, separability, and uniqueness of linear ICA models. IEEE Signal Processing Letters 11(7):601--604, 2004.

attestation.note: The square specialization was checked against the displayed Lemma 11 in the arXiv source; invertibility rules out proportional columns.
